'''Vorel''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of the [[Imperial Guard]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]] stationed on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]. Vorel tasked an Imperial [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to recover the construction plans of [[the Tomb]] with hopes of creating a lookalike [[Space station/Legends|space station]].<ref name="Belsavis Reborn" />
